# Core runtime dependencies.
#
# The memory model itself is standard-library only. `filelock` is needed for
# cross-process locking on the data files; `requests` is needed only when an
# embedding or distillation endpoint is configured.

filelock>=3.13

# Optional: only required if you point OLLAMA_EMBED_URL or
# DISTILLATION_BASE_URL at an HTTP service.
requests>=2.31
